clue.text: Chat about pet heading for usual eatery

parts.note: only its first letter is used

explanation.walkthrough: A pet here is a huff (in a pet), not an animal; strop is British slang for the same bad mood.
explanation.definitionFit: A gastropub is a pub serving good-quality food, so it is a kind of eating place.
